forge_repository_list.title: List authorized repositories
forge_repository_list.description: List the GitHub repositories authorized for this account through the Forge GitHub App. Container-free — use it to pick a repository before starting a task or workspace.

forge_task_start.title: Start a task
forge_task_start.description: Create a durable task record that survives MCP reconnects, context compression and container sleep. Container-free — start a task first for any coherent piece of work, then attach one workspace later only when you need to run or edit code.

repository.description: Authorized GitHub repository to act on.

base_ref.description: The branch or ref the task branches from.

decisions.description: Durable decisions that must survive context compression.

non_goals.description: Things this task deliberately will not do.

likely_paths.description: Files or directories the work is expected to touch.

forge_task_get.title: Get a task
forge_task_get.description: Get the full task record: branch, workspace, previews, files read and changed, checks and evidence ids. Read-only and container-free.

forge_task_summary.title: Summarize a task
forge_task_summary.description: Get a compact resume summary for a task — goal, decisions, non-goals, state, files, checks, evidence, outstanding work and the next recommended action — so a fresh turn can continue without replaying the session. Excludes source, logs, diffs and secrets. Container-free.

forge_task_list.title: List tasks
forge_task_list.description: List recent tasks for the account, most recently updated first, optionally filtered by state or a free-text query. Container-free.

state.description: Only return tasks in this state.

q.description: Free-text filter matched against the goal, repository, and task details (changed files, decisions, outstanding work).

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

forge_task_finish.title: Finish a task
forge_task_finish.description: Move a task to a terminal state (complete, failed or cancelled). Container-free. Finishing as 'complete' is refused when failed/partial checks, unrecorded checks, unpushed changed files or outstanding items are on record — pass force with a note explaining what remains unverified to override.

outcome.description: The terminal state to move the task to.

note.description: Optional closing note added to the task. Required when force is true.

force.description: Override the completion-gap check for outcome complete. Requires note explaining what is unverified.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the revision you expect; the call fails if the workspace or task has moved on.

forge_review.title: Review a deployed URL
forge_review.description: Capture screenshot and accessibility evidence from a live public URL for a strict Parallax review, without starting a container — the cheapest review path. Each cell reports a structure-health signal (structureSummary and evidence[].accessibility.structure) that flags heading defects a screenshot hides — stacked, empty, duplicate or skipped-level headings — which must be resolved or explicitly accepted before the review passes.

viewports.description: Viewports to capture each route at.

full_page.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport.

state.description: Label for the page state being captured.

selection.description: Optional label for what this evidence covers.

forge_workspace_create.title: Create a workspace
forge_workspace_create.description: Create a disposable, isolated workspace (a container) from an authorized repository. Costly — create one only when you need to run or edit code; decide with the container-free task and read tools first. Returns immediately in state 'requested'; poll forge_workspace_get until state is 'ready' (usually under a minute) before use. idempotency_key must be unique per distinct workspace.

repository.description: Authorized GitHub repository to act on.

ref.description: Branch or ref to check out.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Unique key that makes this mutation safe to retry; supply a stable value to make a retry idempotent, or omit it to always execute.

__schema7.description: Unique key that makes this mutation safe to retry; use a fresh value per distinct call.

forge_workspace_get.title: Get a workspace
forge_workspace_get.description: Get a workspace's lifecycle state, repository, revision, processes and previews. Read-only and container-free — poll it after forge_workspace_create until state is 'ready'.

forge_context_get.title: Select repository context
forge_context_get.description: Rank the repository files most relevant to a goal, deterministically (no embeddings, no model). Returns paths with reasons, governing instructions, adjacent tests, package context and warnings — never file contents; you decide what to read. Cheap.

goal.description: What you are trying to do; drives the ranking.

task_id.description: Optional task to associate the lookup with.

max_results.description: Maximum number of files to return.

categories.description: Restrict results to these file categories.

forge_diff_metadata.title: Summarize the outgoing diff
forge_diff_metadata.description: Summarize the outgoing diff into deterministic, compact metadata: changed files, additions/deletions, changed exports, tests, config, migrations, possible secret exposure, risk areas and the files worth reading first, plus targeted verification suggestions. Syntax-only and cheap — inspect the raw diff with forge_git_outgoing_diff before any Git mutation.

base.description: Base branch to diff the current branch against.

forge_files_tree.title: List workspace files
forge_files_tree.description: List a bounded, Git-aware file tree under /workspace. Read-only; needs a ready workspace.

depth.description: How many levels deep to descend.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

forge_files_read.title: Read workspace files
forge_files_read.description: Read one file (path) or several at once (paths) as bounded text, each with a content hash for conflict-safe edits. Reading several in one call saves round trips; start_line/end_line and max_bytes apply to each file. Needs a ready workspace.

paths.description: Several files to read in one call.

forge_files_write.title: Write workspace file
forge_files_write.description: Create or overwrite a whole file with its full content — simpler and more reliable than a diff for full-file changes. Pass expected_sha256 (from forge_files_read) for a conflict-safe overwrite; omit it to create a new file. Parent directories are created automatically; idempotency_key must be unique per distinct write.

expected_sha256.description: Hash the file must currently have, for a conflict-safe overwrite; omit to create.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Unique key that makes this mutation safe to retry; supply a stable value to make a retry idempotent, or omit it to always execute.

__schema1.description: Unique key that makes this mutation safe to retry; use a fresh value per distinct call.

forge_files_patch.title: Apply a file patch
forge_files_patch.description: Apply a unified diff to the repository. Best for surgical multi-hunk edits; for whole-file rewrites prefer forge_files_write (agents often miscount diff context). idempotency_key must be unique per distinct patch.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Unique key that makes this mutation safe to retry; supply a stable value to make a retry idempotent, or omit it to always execute.

forge_shell_exec.title: Run a command
forge_shell_exec.description: Run a foreground command in the workspace with timeout, output and network-policy bounds. Risky commands return a real user approval URL; idempotency_key must be unique per distinct command.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace; must start with /workspace.

timeout_ms.description: Kill the command after this many milliseconds.

network_policy.description: Outbound network policy for this command.

output_limit_bytes.description: Truncate captured output past this many bytes.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the revision you expect; the call fails if the workspace or task has moved on.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Unique key that makes this mutation safe to retry; supply a stable value to make a retry idempotent, or omit it to always execute.

approval_id.description: Approval id returned by a prior blocked call.

forge_process_start.title: Start a background process
forge_process_start.description: Start a long-running background process such as a development server and return its Forge process id immediately. idempotency_key must be unique per distinct process.

command.description: Command to run in the background.

cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace; must start with /workspace.

network_policy.description: Outbound network policy for this process.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the revision you expect; the call fails if the workspace or task has moved on.

forge_process_logs.title: Read process logs
forge_process_logs.description: Read a bounded page of a background process's logs using an opaque cursor. Read-only.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior page.

forge_git_status.title: Read Git status
forge_git_status.description: Get the workspace repository's working-tree and branch status. Read-only.

forge_git_diff.title: Read Git diff
forge_git_diff.description: Get a bounded unified diff of the working tree, or of staged changes. Read-only.

staged.description: Diff staged changes instead of the working tree.

forge_git_branch_create.title: Create a branch
forge_git_branch_create.description: Create and check out a local branch under the required forge/ namespace.

branch.description: Branch name; must start with forge/.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the revision you expect; the call fails if the workspace or task has moved on.

forge_git_commit.title: Commit changes
forge_git_commit.description: Stage the given repository paths and commit them, attributed to forge-mcp[bot]. Omit message to auto-generate a conventional-commit message from the diff.

paths.description: Paths to stage; empty stages all changes.

expected_revision.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the revision you expect; the call fails if the workspace or task has moved on.

forge_git_outgoing_diff.title: Inspect the outgoing change
forge_git_outgoing_diff.description: Get the exact bounded diff and its hash between the base branch and the current forge/ branch. Read-only — inspect this before requesting a push.

forge_submit_for_review.title: Submit finished work for review
forge_submit_for_review.description: Finish a piece of work in one call, without waiting for anyone. Stages the current branch on a Forge-owned ref, queues a pull request for it, and returns immediately — the human approves whenever they like, from the Forge portal or the returned URL, and Forge performs the push and opens the draft PR itself. Prefer this over forge_git_push + forge_pull_request_create, which both block until a human clicks. Any uncommitted work is committed automatically, so this is genuinely one call. The workspace can be destroyed straight after this returns; the staged commits outlive it.

branch.description: forge/ branch the work should land on once approved.

base.description: Branch the pull request will target.

title.description: PR title; omit to auto-generate from the diff.

task_id.description: Task this submission completes, for traceability.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Unique key that makes this mutation safe to retry; supply a stable value to make a retry idempotent, or omit it to always execute.

forge_git_push.title: Push a branch
forge_git_push.description: Push a non-default forge/ branch through the GitHub App credential proxy. Requires a real user approval page and the expected diff hash.

expected_diff_hash.description: diffHash from forge_git_outgoing_diff; the push fails if the diff changed.

approval_id.description: Approval id from the approval page.

forge_pull_request_create.title: Open a draft pull request
forge_pull_request_create.description: Open a draft GitHub pull request for an already-pushed forge/ branch. Requires a real user approval page. Omit title to auto-generate the title and body from the branch diff.

head.description: forge/ branch to open the PR from.

approval_id.description: Approval id from the approval page.

forge_task_authorize_push_envelope.title: Pre-authorize a run of pushes
forge_task_authorize_push_envelope.description: Ask a human to authorize, ONCE, a bounded envelope covering the next several forge_git_push calls to one branch — for tasks that iterate in many small commit-then-push cycles, so the human is not asked to click through every single push. A push only auto-satisfies inside the envelope while it (a) fast-forwards the same branch/base with no rewritten history, and (b) touches only paths under allowed_paths; anything else falls back to a normal, individually-approved push. Never covers forge_pull_request_create, which always needs its own approval. Requires a real user approval page, same as a push.

task_id.description: Task this envelope belongs to, for traceability.

base.description: Base branch, fixed for the life of the envelope.

allowed_paths.description: Path prefixes the envelope covers. Omit to default to the paths in the current outgoing diff.

ttl_minutes.description: How long the envelope stays valid.

approval_id.description: Approval id from the approval page.

forge_preview_expose.title: Expose a preview
forge_preview_expose.description: Expose a running process through a short-lived Forge preview capability. Private by default; public access requires approval.

ttl_seconds.description: How long the preview stays open.

forge_review_capture.title: Capture preview review evidence
forge_review_capture.description: Capture screenshot and accessibility evidence from a running Forge preview — one packet across bounded routes, states and viewports. Give a capture `steps` to drive a real interaction (click/fill/press/wait) before the shot, proving multi-step flows a static screenshot cannot. Inspect each image with forge_artifact_get; this is the only preview-evidence tool.

viewports.description: Viewports to capture each route at.

state.description: Label for the page state being captured.

selection.description: Optional label for what this evidence covers.

steps.description: Interaction to drive before the shot.

forge_artifact_get.title: Get an artifact
forge_artifact_get.description: Fetch a stored Forge artifact. Image artifacts are returned as MCP image content for direct model inspection. Read-only.

forge_workspace_destroy.title: Destroy a workspace
forge_workspace_destroy.description: Destroy a workspace: revoke previews and capabilities, stop processes and tear down the container. Do this once the task or review is complete. Refused when the repository has committed changes on a forge/ branch that were never pushed — pass force to destroy anyway and accept the loss.

force.description: Destroy even if the workspace has unpushed committed work.
